event: Windows sleep and hibernation interrupted wall-clock training
reporting_note: Recorded train_minutes is elapsed wall-clock time including the overnight sleep/hibernate pause; it must not be described as active GPU training time or directly compared with historical active training duration. Original logs remain unchanged.
mitigation: src/training_awake.py holds a verified Windows ES_CONTINUOUS|ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED request while process4844 is alive, then releases it. Display and manual sleep are unaffected.
